library(tidyverse)

```{r fig5}
plot_df <- read_tsv("./Input_files/Repeat_GSEA.tsv") %>%
    mutate(pathway = reorder(pathway, NES))
# reformat values for capitalizing
plot_df$Significant <- ifelse(plot_df$Significant == "NO", "No", "Yes")

# plot_df %>% ggplot() +
#   geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey60") +
#   geom_point(aes(x= NES, y= pathway, size = leading_no, fill = Significant), color="black", pch = 21) +
#   scale_fill_manual(values=c("darkorange", "darkblue"))+  
#   labs(x = "Normalized Enrichment Score", y = NULL, title = "", size = "Leading Edges", fill = "padj < 0.05") +
#   theme_cowplot(12) +
#   background_grid(major = "y", minor = "none") +
#   theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
#   guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 3, byrow = TRUE, title.position = "top"), size = guide_legend(nrow = 4, byrow = TRUE, title.position = "top"))

fig5 <- plot_df %>% ggplot() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey60") +
  geom_point(aes(x= NES, y= pathway, size = leading_no, fill = Significant), color="black", pch = 21) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("darkorange", "darkblue"))+  
  labs(x = "Normalized Enrichment Score", y = NULL, title = "", size = "Leading Edges", fill = "Significant") +
  theme_cowplot(12) +
  background_grid(major = "y", minor = "none") +
  theme(  legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.box = "horizontal",
    #legend.box.just = "center",
    legend.justification = "center") +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 3, byrow = TRUE, title.position = "top"), 
         size = guide_legend(nrow = 4, byrow = TRUE, title.position = "top"))

plot(fig5)

ggsave(
  "Fig5.tiff",
  plot   =fig5,
  device = ragg::agg_tiff,
  width  = 85, height = 110, units = "mm",
  res    = 300,
  compression = "lzw",
  bg = "white"
)
  

```
